title: Moment 4: Family and friends, The people who matter, first
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Dev never again misses a birthday or a long silence. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Dev's dashboard starts with the birthdays coming soon.
Nia's is in 6 days and Grandma Ruth's is in 19 days.
It notices he last talked with Uncle Sam 74 days ago, and with old friend Jun 41 days ago.
A message to Sam is drafted: thinking of you, free Sunday for a call? It waits for Dev's yes.
Shared plans show Sunday 4 PM, a call with Sam, and Saturday, Nia's recital.
